_comment: Data for scripts/conformance/check_static.py.  The per-function sentinel
table is DATA, not a heuristic, because the conventions genuinely differ
per function and a checker that flagged correct code would train every
reader to ignore it.  Verified against protoCore/core/ProtoObject.cpp and

getAttribute.cite: core/ProtoObject.cpp:773-781 -- 'nullptr is reserved for invalid input, not missing'

getOwnAttributeDirect.cite: headers/protoCore.h -- returns nullptr BOTH for absent and for a non-object receiver, and cannot distinguish them

hasAttribute.note: returns a boolean OBJECT, never a C++ bool: PROTO_TRUE is 1217UL and PROTO_FALSE is 193UL, so both are non-null and a raw if() is ALWAYS true

hasOwnAttribute.note: same: a boolean OBJECT, never a C++ bool
